title: A request in a Latin language the reading does not know (Norwegian, Danish, Swedish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese) is never read as Dutch and so never makes the agent reply in Dutch; the agent is shown every class that lays an element out (a menu's pill class) and told to look for a layout in the settings of the record that prints it
steps: S1: run packages/core/tracy-core/test/language.test.mjs: 75 sentences in 12 languages the reading does not know, and real Dutch with short words other languages also use.
S2: run packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/look-style.test.mjs: describeTarget on a Joomla menu list whose class list is `mod-menu mod-list nav nav-pills`.
S3: run packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/ds-slot-worn.test.mjs: the LOOK line carries the layout sentence on every platform and only in the modes that can change a look.
expect: S1: no sentence of the 75 reads as 'nl'; the four Dutch sentences still read 'nl'; Vietnamese is unchanged.
S2: the agent is told <ul.mod-menu.mod-list.nav.nav-pills>, not <ul.mod-menu.mod-list>; no name is longer than 79 characters.
S3: the sentence is present for wordpress, joomla and emdash with the designer mode and absent for a mode that cannot change a look.
evidence: 22/10/2026, a real imported Joomla site (customer in Norway): six requests for a horizontal menu answered 'done' with no change on the page (the menu module carried the class nav-pills), and the customer reported the site had switched to Dutch. Measured on the unchanged code: 18 of 75 (Norwegian 6 of 11, Danish 5 of 8, Swedish 5 of 8, Italian 2 of 8) sentences of 12 other languages read as Dutch. After: 0 of 75.
fence: Dutch wins only while its words outnumber the signs of another Latin language; describeTarget names up to six classes per element and still cuts a name at 78 characters; the layout sentence is the LOOK_CHECK's own and names no platform or template

tests: a sentence in a Latin language the reading does not know is never read as Dutch
Dutch with short words other languages also use still reads as Dutch
describeTarget names an element with every class that lays it out, so a menu pill class is seen
LOOK line: a layout is sought in the settings of the record that prints it, and done is said for what was asked: joomla
